versions.content: The Freshness Manager provides or receives freshness information in interface functions as byte arrays. The freshness is always aligned to the MSB of the first byte in the array. The 8th bit of the freshness is the MSB of the 2nd byte and so on. Unused bits of the freshness array must be set to 0. The associated length information must be given in bits.
